note: the “Fiddle”: the fugue of the G minor violin sonata, BWV 1001; from the Prelude and Fugue
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal's line is the bass. Much of this fugue is chords, as on the violin it was written for; the notes that fit in no voice are written into a neighboring voice's chords.
